evaluatedInstruction: What happened in this decision? Answer the five scenario questions.

selectedOption.summary: Invite-only, single-tenant Northstar beta Oct 15, 2026; GA Nov 1, 2026

answer.whatWasDecided: Ship an invite-only, single-tenant Northstar CSV beta on October 15, 2026, then complete general availability on November 1, 2026.
answer.why: The Northstar beta uniquely fit the reduced 14 engineer-day capacity and delivers usable CSV before Northstar Health’s November 1 deadline.
answer.whatChanged: Engineering capacity was reduced from 18 to 14 days because of a four-day incident rotation; the 18-day full-CSV GA October 15 option was replaced by the 14-day Northstar beta, leaving 4 post-launch engineer-days.
answer.whatRemainsOpen: Keep beta scope within 14 days, finish the remaining 4 engineer-days by November 1, and have Northstar validate beta usability.
answer.whoRatified: Maya Chen, Product Lead, ratified the prepared decision through the ordinary UI.

executionMode: A fresh gpt-5.6-terra/medium decider chose both read-only calls from native descriptions; the coordinator relayed them unchanged through one isolated in-app Browser WebMCP handle.
